sn7.22:1.2: ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Khomadussaṃ nāma Sakyānaṃ nigame || || 2.
sn7.22:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Khomadussam nigamam piṇḍāya pāvisi || || 3.
sn7.22:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena Khomadussakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā sabhāyaṃ sannipatitā honti kenacid eva karaṇīyena || devo ca ekam ekaṃ phusāyati || || 4.
sn7.22:1.5: Atha kho Bhagavā yena sā sabhā ten-upasaṅkami || || 5.
sn7.22:1.6: Addasaṃsu Khomadussakā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā Bhagavantam dūrato va āgacchantam || || 6.
sn7.22:1.8: Ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā ke ca sabhādhammaṃ jānissantī ti || || 7.
sn7.22:1.9: Atha kho Bhagavā Khomadussake- brāhmaṇa-gahapatike gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.22:2.1: N-esā sabhā yattha na santi santo ||
sn7.22:2.2: santo na te ye na vadanti dhammaṃ ||
sn7.22:2.3: rāgañ ca dosañ ca pahāya mohaṃ ||
sn7.22:2.4: dhammaṃ vadantā va bhavanti santo ti || || 8.
sn7.22:3.1: Evaṃ vutte Khomadussakā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn7.22:3.2: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama abhikkantam bho Gotama ||
sn7.22:3.3: seyyathāpi bho Gotama nikujjitaṃ vā ukujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggam ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhinti || evam eva bhotā Gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito || ||
sn7.22:3.4: Ete mayam Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca ||
sn7.22:3.5: upāsake no bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate ti || ||
